correctness.rationale: A first-principles update of last-letter distinct subsequences gives the 4-state conditional Markov recursion, whose resolvent yields the stated rational generating function. An exact determinant identity factors as \(t^2(t+s)^2-pq(t+1)^2\), identifies the positive Perron root and justifies the nth-root limit for all positive transitions. A second implicit equation proves strictly positive derivative at every fixed stationary frequency. The actual package verifier passed 67 exact rational parameter pairs (603 direct expectations, 68,474 enumerated hosts) and symbolic equality for the determinant and numerator. The finite experiments corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The underlying 2017 work explicitly identifies Markov exponential growth as a problem to solve. The theorem replaces a four-dimensional numerical recursion by a closed radical and an exact all-length scalar generating function, then determines which serial-dependence parameter maximizes expected deletion-readout diversity while keeping the stationary composition fixed. This bias-controlled sharp extremum at a run-forbidding boundary is a natural and reusable structural fact, not an arbitrary finite computation.
